lines.text: Healthy before, that lead. Now it is something much more serious!
Gone is the breathing room for the chaser, and the road out front is long and empty!
Hear that? That is the sound of a gap getting wider.
Tight at the top a while ago. Rather less tight now!
This is how leads are built: quietly, calmly, one winning season after another!
Bit by bit, season by season, a lead is turning into a lock!
The Showdown is leaning hard to one side now, and you can feel it from the cheap seats.
Cruising altitude for one dugout, turbulence for the other.
Calm, clinical, out of sight. That is how you stretch a lead.
Feel that shift? The lead is no longer a lead. It is a problem for the chaser to solve.
A comfortable lead is no place to rest, and nobody in the front dugout is resting.
Slowly and surely the drawbridge goes up, and the leader is on the safe side of it!
You hear it all the time, no lead is safe. This one is working hard to prove it wrong.
Winning breeds winning, and the leader has caught the habit!
Oh, that is a gap the other dugout will feel tonight.
Unstoppable? Not quite. But it is making an awfully good impression of it!
What a position to be in. Further clear, and still hungry!
The longer this goes, the more it looks like one manager's Showdown.
They call it a Showdown, but the leader is making it look like a stroll.
Time is running, and every winning season takes a bit more of it from the chaser.
If this were a marathon, the leader would be turning round to wave about now.
Breathe, chaser. It is a long road still, but a serious stretch has opened up!
No fuss, no drama, just a clean win and a lead that keeps growing.
Watch that gap, folks. It does not want to close, and nobody is helping it!
A little breathing space is gold in a Showdown, and there is plenty of it now!
That gap did not just grow, it stretched, and somebody is holding the tape!
Do not take your eyes off this one. The lead is on a roll, and so is the leader!
There is a lead, then a cushion, then whatever this is. A fortress, perhaps.
Sit back, leader. Well, not too far back. The lead is growing, but the chase is still on.
Watching this is like watching a train pick up speed on a long straight!
It is a lead you can feel from the other side of the room.
One more win, and what once looked like a race looks more like a solo run.
Another one banked, another notch up the ladder, and the view from the top is getting lovely!
Quiet confidence in one dugout, quiet worry in the other. That is how leads feel!
Making it look easy is the hardest trick in the game, and the leader just pulled it off!
The gap now stands at {margin}, and nobody out front is looking back!
Daylight, that is what the lead has found. Daylight, and {margin} of it!
Take a long look at the gap. It reads {margin} now, and it did not shrink this season!
Out in front by {margin}, and every season adds another brick to the wall.
{leader} wins again, and the gap to {trailer} just got a little wider!
Another season, another win for {leader}, and the horizon keeps sliding away from {trailer}.
Pulling clear now, {leader}, and the rear lights are getting smaller for {trailer}!
You wonder how {trailer} responds to this. {leader} has made a big lead bigger.
{winnerClub} again, and the lead grows. The chasing pack is a pack of one now.
Grip tightening, nerves steady, and {leader} puts another season in the bank.
Season {season} goes to {winnerClub}, and the Showdown tilts a little further their way.
{trailer} needed an answer, and {leader} has supplied another question instead!
Some leads make the other dugout go quiet, and {leader} has just built one of them.
Running out of road, {loserClub}, and the leader is still accelerating!
What does {trailer} do now? The lead is stretching out, and {leader} is not finished!
{leader} adds another winning season, and the lead reads {margin} now.
A lead of {margin} for {winnerClub}, and the nearest rival is squinting into the distance!
It is {margin} between them, and {leader} is still pushing for more!
Once, {trailer} cut the deficit. {leader} has slammed that door.
Steady hands at the wheel, {leader}, and the road ahead is clear!
Keep an eye on {winnerClub}, because they are not slowing down and the gap is not closing!
{trailer} gave chase, but the lead only grew, and the chaser is breathing hard.
Winning once is good. Winning again and stretching the lead is how {leader} starts to sound like a favorite!
Make no mistake, that was a statement from {leader}.
Not a flicker of doubt from {winner}, and a long think ahead for {loserClub}!
Work of a manager who will not lift the foot off the pedal. {leader} wins, and wins again!
Pressure from behind? Not for {leader}, who has stretched the lead and the smile!
{winnerClub} in front, and in front again, and further in front than ever!
Another victory means another chunk of advantage, and {winnerClub} will take every bit!
{leader} makes it look easy, and that is the most worrying thing of all for the chaser.
Smoothly done by {winnerClub}, and the Showdown feels a little more settled than before.
Fresh from a win, {leader} looks every inch the favorite, and the other dugout has questions.
{trailer} will need a big, big season to fix this, because the lead is moving out of reach.
Up goes the advantage, up goes the confidence, and up goes the volume in the {winnerClub} dugout!
Every season {leader} wins, the chasing job gets harder.
Look how far {leader} has traveled, and look how far there is still to go for the chase.
Hats off to {winnerClub}, who just moved the finish line a little further from {loserClub}!
A season to remember for {winner}, a long think for {loser}, and a Showdown that leans again.
Out ahead, further out ahead, and still going. That is {leader} all over!
Everything {trailer} builds, the leader seems to top. That is the story right now.
Confidence is a lead you carry in your head, and {leader} is carrying plenty!
{leader} will sleep well tonight, and the chaser will stare at the ceiling.
Ahead before, further ahead now. {leader} keeps adding to the story!
What a grip {leader} has on this Showdown, and it is tightening!
Round after round, {winnerClub} keep winning, and the lead grows with the applause!
Solid, professional, and one more step beyond the chase. That is the {winnerClub} way.
{leader}, you have made this look rather straightforward. {trailer} would disagree.
The race for the lead is now a race to catch up, and {trailer} is the one running!
Add one more winning season to the pile, and {leader} has something very comfortable to sit on.
Leaders lead, and {leader} has led from the front again!
Touch of class from {winnerClub}, and a touch of worry for the other dugout.
Some managers coast. {leader} accelerates, and the lead goes with it!
Watch {leader} now: head down, jaw set, and the lead still getting bigger.
For {trailer}, the climb just got steeper. For {leader}, the view just got better!
Brace yourself, {loserClub}. The leader is in no mood to share the road!
Reliable as ever, {winnerClub} chalk up another win and stretch the gap.
Quietly, relentlessly, {leader} keeps turning seasons into advantages!
It is all going {winnerClub}'s way, and {loserClub} will have to change the script.
{winner} wears this lead like a tailored suit.
Ask {trailer} how the lead looks from back there. Long, and getting longer!
Credit where it is due: {winnerClub} turned a good position into a commanding one!
Settled is a comforting word in the {winnerClub} camp, and a worrying one for {loserClub}.
Late at night, the console hums, and {leader} has another season to smile about!
One more for the collection, {winner}, and the lead looks sturdier than ever.
They keep coming for {leader}, and {leader} keeps going further clear!
